mcp.description: Enable your AI assistant to use more external tools like web search, file operations, database queries, and more. Think of it like installing 'Apps' for your AI to make it more powerful.

help.content:
External tools let your AI assistant perform more tasks, such as:

• Search the web
• Read and write local files
• Query databases
• Send emails
• Manage calendars

Each tool is like an 'App' - once installed, your AI can use them when needed.
